not_byte_identical.ln/exactln/__init__.py: five hunks, no arithmetic / source / compile-option / launch change: the four `from cuda.bindings import driver|nvrtc` statements resolve through `_bindings(name)` (cuda.bindings when importable, else the ctypes bindings in cubind.py; OPT_CORE_EXACTLN_BINDINGS=ctypes forces the latter), `facts()['bindings']` reports which served, the module docstring says so; plus the bundle lookup (_prebuilt_index / _prebuilt_function / _opts, consulted first in _compile; facts prebuilt_hits / prebuilt_off) -- no arithmetic / source / option change; plus the cache-directory rule (_private_cache_dir, consulted in _cache_dir: a cubin directory another account could have written is refused by name and a private one used; cubin files written 0644)
not_byte_identical.ln/exactln/build_prebuilt.py: house-written builder of that payload (NVRTC cross-compiles both archs on any card; python -m opt_core.kernels.ln.exactln.build_prebuilt)
not_byte_identical.ln/exactln/cubind.py: house-written addition (not in the donor): the CUDA driver API + NVRTC entry points exactln calls, bound through ctypes (libcuda.so.1; the libnvrtc torch ships / loads or the toolkit's) with cuda.bindings' return convention -- serves the images that lack the cuda-python wheel
not_byte_identical.ln/exactln/prebuilt/: house-built payload (not in the donor): exactln_fwd-sm90.cubin + exactln_fwd-sm80.cubin + index.json -- the 40 (form, C, affine) instantiations the cells serve, one NVRTC program per arch from the shipped exactln_fwd.cu with the module's options; a serving process loads the module and compiles nothing (facts prebuilt_hits); OPT_CORE_EXACTLN_PREBUILT=0 = compile as before
not_byte_identical.ln/fastln/lpout.py: house-written addition (not in the donor): the carried row kernel with fp32 arithmetic pinned and the OUTPUT dtype named (layer_norm_lp; the bf16o form: bf16 x, fp32 parameters and statistics, bf16 out)
